name: BADGER HOME SAUNA
description:
The Badger Home Infrared Sauna is a beautiful Single Person Far Infrared Sauna designed to help individuals achieve optimal wellness. Ideal for compact and smaller spaces, this healthy oasis is complimentary to any spa, wellness center, or home.

Detoxify your body and discover amazing results with a Badger Sauna without breaking the bank or taking up large amounts of space. Setup is a breeze - easy to assemble. Plug into any 3 prong standard household outlet. 120 Volt/15 Amp circuit. Now you're ready to step into relaxing natural warmth in minutes!

Badger Sauna shown is with standard Hemlock wood.
